review_method: Read-only audit of the locally retrieved latest RunPod attempt and its sealed validation records. No cloud/API call, result rewrite, test run, or resource action was performed.

partial_validation.acceptance_interpretation: The 17 completed 4096-token inputs provide partial native-versus-optimized numerical agreement for 408 expert cases. They do not establish full screen acceptance, the 2048-token context, a whole-device peak upper bound, or scientific collection readiness.

observed_runtime_and_memory.memory_interpretation: Observed values from completed 4096-token screen cases only; not a complete workload peak bound or validate_fit acceptance.

Preserve the original receipt; add environment forwarding only to a future candidate and record the resulting identity explicitly.

future_run_image_provenance_review.method: Read-only source review. No provider calls, resource mutations, receipt edits, or tests run by this reviewer.

package.assessment: verify_package requires the frozen identity base_image to equal the controller IMAGE constant before preflight proceeds. The create request uses that same constant, and matches_attempt requires the pod read-back image to equal it. This provides a consistent declared image chain for the new attempt.

remote_binding.assessment: The remote helper first verifies its own uploaded hash against identity.local_files, then bind_image_identity accepts only a sha256-pinned base_image, rejects a conflicting inherited RESEARCH_IMAGE_DIGEST, sets the variable for child processes, and records declared_image plus an explicit non-attestation source label. This propagates the candidate/controller-declared identity; it does not inspect or attest the container image from inside the container.

test_coverage.reported_focused_test_result: 44 passed, reported by coordinator; not independently rerun in this read-only review.
covered: missing SSH environment inherits the pinned identity into a child process
missing, unpinned, malformed, or non-hex digest rejected
changed uploaded helper rejected before stages start
test_coverage.gap: I did not find a focused test that calls the real verify_package with otherwise-valid archives and a mismatched base_image, nor an assertion that a successful runner receipt contains the exact declared_image and non-attestation source label. The implementation checks are present, but those two provenance-contract branches are not directly regression-tested in the reviewed tests.

future_run_image_provenance_review.prior_receipt_handling: The earlier native receipt and its null runtime_image_digest remain unchanged. This fix applies only to a future run; it cannot backfill or upgrade the provenance of the existing partial attempt.
future_run_image_provenance_review.conclusion: Future-run declared image identity propagation is internally consistent and accurately labeled as declaration rather than container attestation. No blocker found in the reviewed implementation; the stated focused-test coverage gap is non-blocking but worth adding before the next prepared package is frozen.
